import hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path("/home/udt-admin/udt_mass_codex")
step=root/"udt_phase_current_product_persistence_campaign_2026-09-07/step_03"
cases=[("replay_author","author_exact",0,None),("replay_omit_area","mutant_omit_area",1,"full_phase_label_volume_coarea"),("replay_omit_normal_flux","mutant_omit_normal_flux",1,"current_flux_matches_quotient"),("replay_past_phase","mutant_past_phase",1,"full_future_phase_normalization"),("replay_ignore_product","mutant_ignore_product",1,"conserved_nonproduct_rejected")]
summary=[]
for replay,old,code,guard in cases:
    record=json.loads((step/"review"/(replay+".json")).read_text())
    assert record["returncode"]==code and not record["timeout"]
    for suffix in [".stdout",".stderr"]:
        assert (step/"review"/(replay+suffix)).read_bytes()==(step/(old+suffix)).read_bytes(),(replay,suffix)
    data=json.loads((step/"review"/(replay+".stdout")).read_text())
    if guard is not None: assert data["guard"]==guard and data["status"]=="FAIL"
    else: assert data["status"]=="PASS" and data["guard_count"]==16
    summary.append(dict(replay=replay,byte_identical=True,returncode=code,guard=guard,duration=record["duration_seconds"],maxrss_kib=record["maxrss_kib"]))
for prefix in ["source_first","compare_frozen"]:
    assert (step/"review"/(prefix+".stderr")).stat().st_size==0
print(json.dumps(dict(replays=summary,argument_sha256=hashlib.sha256((step/"CANDIDATE_ARGUMENT.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()),indent=2,sort_keys=True))
